description: This source file implements functions for managing application key files, including generating file paths with specific suffixes, creating key files, and checking for the existence of 'good' key files within a directory.

classes.name: starboard::ScopedFile
classes.description: A RAII wrapper for file descriptor management, ensuring proper closing of files.

methods.name: GetAppKeyFilePathWithSuffix
methods.description: Constructs a file path for an app key with a specified suffix within a directory.

methods.name: GetGoodAppKeyFilePath
methods.description: Returns the file path for a 'good' app key file in a directory.

methods.name: GetBadAppKeyFilePath
methods.description: Returns the file path for a 'bad' app key file in a directory.

methods.name: CreateAppKeyFile
methods.description: Creates a new app key file at the specified path.

methods.name: AnyGoodAppKeyFile
methods.description: Checks if any 'good' app key file exists in the specified directory.
